summary: 51 of 60 pass (85%). Labels 36 of 41, cuts 14 of 17, retypes 1 of 2. No quote is fabricated; one is misplaced (the Oblique Portrait quote lives in Harvest Ceremony — Context, not on the target) and one adds emphasis to the Quality Manifesto's line. Each failure has one of two causes. The three failed cuts are reasons the reader did not look for: the pages give a reason in a companion file or another face, not in the body. Retrospective Delay's rich face captions the shrinking tape 'See [[Frequency-Time Duality]]'. Trickster's own definition and Open Questions name the delay line a trickster instrument. Loudon's note in Cooperation Yields Agency's Context says the symbiosis was 'predicted in this entry and in [[Symbiotic Skills]]'. The other failures are labels that put a reason on a page that hasn't stated it. Tier-one-context belongs to the Palace Enchantment link beside it. The-personality-tier answers a question Loudon's graffiti leaves open. Roster-voice claims a roster place three citizens do not have. Up-to-us retypes a link both pages are silent on. The shelf and Core Five labels for the Source Library members, the ceremony-row labels, and the mechanical pair folds are solid. The reader's no-sentence stance held everywhere except Stoicism ↔ Quality Manifesto, which should be cut unless Loudon wants a sentence.
